hypothesis: Price-based 5m approaches saturate ~2.4%/mo, so new information must come from elsewhere. Test whether NON-PRICE signal sources carry incremental value: daily derivatives positioning/OI context (lag48 archive scenario) and causal kline flow/activity features, alone and combined, with zero raw-price features. Control is the same HGB walk-forward on candle40 only, so any gap is attributable to the feature source, not the model or policy.
family: derivatives/flow-feature CPU model, purged monthly walk-forward, new signal source

feature_sources.deriv40_lag48: artifacts/features/btc_derivatives_lag48_v1/features.npz:features (20 daily OI/positioning log-level/change + 20 missing masks, source_day+48h archive-lag scenario, row-aligned 5628)
feature_sources.flow40: computed in-script via agentic_alpha_lab.data.flow_features.flow_features on dataset candles at v4 signal_times (40 causal closed-candle buy-imbalance/activity/volume features x 5 timeframes, verified finite 5628x40 in Phase 1)

label: examples.npz labels (n,16,3): channel0 unconditional net percent (0 if unfilled), channel1 OHLC fill indicator, channel2 positive-net given fill. Shared action-value regressors: net on ch0, fill on ch1; prediction ch0 = net/fill (conditional), ch4 = logit(fill). Exactly the v8/train_adaptive_action_model mapping. Exploratory labels on opened development data.
folds: purged monthly walk-forward: for each calendar month M in 2023-06..2026-03, fit_at = first-of-month 00:00Z; train mask = label_end < fit_at - 8d AND signal_time >= fit_at - 730d; predict all decisions with signal_time in M. Embargo 8d >= 7d max holding horizon. Minimum 200 mature train decisions per fit (else STOP with error). 34 fits per feature branch. No threshold/sizing/direction tuning on fold outcomes.

model.note: Exactly v8 hyperparams; no scaling/PCA (trees); single seed (CPU budget, HGB near-deterministic)

policy: Standard choose() with UNCHANGED v5 thresholds (minimum_expected_net_percent 0.3, minimum_fill_score 0.25) + identical frequency loop (cooldown 5d, max 4/month) as the r1a gen_signals replica. Entry/brackets/holding grid [3,7] unchanged. Branches x sizing {1x, dd_guard}; dd_guard = 0.5x while own-branch 1x sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after, past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed) is >10% under its trailing peak, else 1.0.

backtest.execution: entry_expiry 12 bars, max_holding 2016 bars (7d); 1x lev 1.0/1.0; dd_guard lev 0.25/1.0
backtest.duration: monthly_geometric_net = ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1 with duration from parent_plan (2023-06-01 to 2026-03-23)

causality_disclosure: Derivatives availability is proxied by source_day+48h, NOT observed historical receipt time (upstream manifest point_in_time_availability_verified=false). Results are a disclosed exploratory lag sensitivity, not live-fillable evidence. Flow features use only closed candles strictly before each signal_time. All fits use only mature labels (8d embargo). No live approval.
rules: fit on train-window mature labels only
pre-specified matrix, no changes after backtests
